title: Antifreezing hydrogels: from mechanisms and strategies to applications

Dong Zhang, Hong Chen, Yanxian Zhang, Jintao Yang, Qiang Chen, Jiang Wu, Yonglan Liu, Chao Zhao, Yijing Tang, Jie Zheng
Antifreezing hydrogels, as an innovative solution for maintaining functional performance and mechanical integrity in subzero environments, offer a robust alternative to traditional water-free materials that often fail in wet, cold conditions.
